title: Nominate to Celebrate: Show the World Who Powers Your Trades Business
summary: Celebrate your team for Day of the Trades! Nominate your business on social media by Dec 2 to win a $500 Visa gift card. Enter today!
body_markdown:
# *The Day of the Trades is Saturday, Dec 12.*


Behind every great trades business is a team that delivers. The technician staying late to restore a family's heat. The dispatcher keeping hundreds of customers informed. The apprentice mastering the craft, and the veteran leading the way. Ahead of Day of the Trades, we're helping you publicly recognize and thank the people who drive your success.


That's why we're launching **Nominate to Celebrate**


: a chance for trades businesses to recognize a team member, a team, or a company win on social media, and to show the world what skilled work makes possible.


## **What you can celebrate**


Choose one per post:


-


**A company accomplishment:**


a milestone, a growth goal, or a community project.


-


**A team's contribution:**


an install crew, dispatch, CSRs, or your office team.


-


**A team member:**


a tech, an apprentice, a manager, or a long-tenured employee.


## **How to enter**


Participating requires just one post, a few tags, and a quick form. Entries open **Nov 13**


and close **Dec 2 at 11:59 p.m. PT**


.


-


**Post publicly**


on Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, X, or TikTok.


-


**Include a photo or video**


of the person, team, or accomplishment you're celebrating.


-


**Tell your story in the caption:**


Explain why you're celebrating, describe the impact on your customers or community, and highlight how it embodies Day of the Trades.


-


**Tag @servicetitan**


and use **#DayoftheTrades #Sweepstakes**


in your caption.


-


**Submit your post link**


through the[entry form](https://forms.gle/n1rEbg9jcagr2Hh38) .


You don't need to be a ServiceTitan customer to enter! Let's celebrate everyone in the trades business.


## **The prize**


We will randomly select ten winning trades businesses from all eligible entries. Each winner will receive a **$500 digital Visa gift card**


to celebrate with their team. Winners will be drawn on or around Dec 4, with gift cards delivered by Dec 11—just in time for Day of the Trades. Limit one entry per company. No purchase necessary.


## **Join us on Dec 12**


Day of the Trades honors the essential professionals who keep our homes and communities running smoothly. We will announce the winners across ServiceTitan's social channels and showcase entry highlights leading up to the event. Engage with your peers by liking, commenting on, and sharing their stories—celebrating others inspires us all.


**Ready?**


[Submit your entry](https://forms.gle/n1rEbg9jcagr2Hh38) by Dec 2 at 11:59 p.m. PT. *No purchase necessary. Open to owners, employees, and authorized representatives of U.S. trades businesses, 18+. Void where prohibited. See*


[Official Rules](https://www.servicetitan.com/legal/nominate-to-celebrate-promo-rules) *for details.*
